findings.passage: I have spent my career defending free speech, election integrity, and the Constitution in court and winning for conservative Americans.
findings.note: From his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey answers (2026). General statement that he has defended election integrity in court. It does not mention voter ID or proof of citizenship.

findings.passage: Defended free speech, election integrity, and the Constitution before the U.S. Supreme Court and courts nationwide.
findings.note: Line on his campaign home page (page undated; read 2026-10-22). Describes his past legal work in general terms. No ID or citizenship detail.

findings.passage: There is too much distrust in our election process, so I look forward to playing a significant role in reforming Texas’s election laws and building a sustainable election integrity program that helps guarantee the fair and transparent elections that Texans deserve,
findings.note: Quote attributed to Chris Gober, CEO of the Gober Group, in a press release from another person's campaign for Texas state-committee chair that named him to build election-law policies. It speaks of reforming election laws in general and does not mention ID or citizenship. The quote ends with a comma in the release because the attribution follows.
